 Angry Crab Shack Orange Beach AL: Cajun Seafood, Seafood Boils & Live Music
 
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack in Orange Beach, AL has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu? Visit us today, we are located in the Palm Point Shopping Plaza on Perdido Beach Blvd.

 OUR REVIEWS
With 4 1/2 out of 5 stars on Google, customers love Angry Crab Shack! Check out some of the best reviews for our Orange Beach location:
Brittany – ★★★★★
“Love that this place is open later than a lot of other restaurants in the area and that they have take out. I placed a takeout order and it was ready very quickly. The gumbo is delicious and seasoned perfectly. I also had the fried soft-shell crab basket with Cajun fries and it was excellent. Everything was fried perfectly and seasoned well and just straight-up delicious.”
Chris – ★★★★★
“Love it. Ate take out twice on our trip. Loved the shrimp boils.”
Kanina – ★★★★★
“Great experience. Our server was amazing! Great food.”

hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! mentions.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. Sandwiches, Burgers, Lobster Rolls, Po’Boys and more are waiting for you!  shrimpandgrits (1)  JAMBALAYA	Traditional spicy Creole base with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and rice. OTHER MENUS:  DINNER MENU  ⬤  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ORDER ONLINE  PCH_Logo  Benefiting Phoenix Children’s Hospital On behalf of all our patient families at Phoenix Children’s Hospital, we are honored and excited to partner with Angry Crab Shack and their customers in support of our patients. Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients. By dining at Angry Crab Shack and ordering one of the PCH Menu items, you are making a difference for children in our community. Great food for a great cause.

structuredData.description: The Angry Crab Shack is a seafood restaurant famous for its Cajun flavor and seafood boils. Our crab house in Orange Beach, AL is serving up all your favorite seafood - fish, shrimp, oysters, crawfish, lobster, crab and more. Made into delicious Cajun dishes like jambalaya and gumbo, and classics like poboys, clam chowder, fish & chips and of course, our seafood boils. Pick your favorite seafood, sauces, spices and sides for a customized feast you're sure to love. Bring your family and friends to the Angry Crab Shack in Peoria to share in the experience, and let's get crackin'!

 Angry Crab Shack 
 Everett, WA 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

	
 
 The Best Cajun Seafood Boils in Everett, WA
Seafood boil restaurant with bold Asian-Cajun flavors. With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack in Everett has something for every seafood lover.
Now Open!   Angry Crab Shack in Everett, WA.

 
	

	
 
 CALL NOW

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack Everett lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick your seafood
Add a signature sauce
Spice up your boil
Add-in a side

 OUR REVIEWS
With 4 out of 5 stars on Google, customers love Angry Crab Shack! Check out some of the best reviews for our Everett, Washington location:
Rachel – ★★★★★
“Angry Crab is an exceptional seafood restaurant that I highly recommend. From the moment you step inside, you are greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere. One of the standout features of Angry Crab is their unique dining experience. You are given a bib and scissors to crack open the crab legs yourself. It’s a fun and interactive way to enjoy your meal! The service & food, and seafood freshness at Angry Crab are top-notch. We will come back to get more delicious dishes. Must try for seafood lovers!”
Joelle – ★★★★★
“My friends and I visited this restaurant tonight and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The food was delicious! Three of us tried the seafood boils and one had fish and chips. The trifecta seasoning on the boils was so good! The drinks were tasty as well. The customer service was fantastic. The owner was very personable, as was the wait staff. Highly recommend this place.”
More Reviews

 OUR REVIEWS
With 3.4 out of 5 stars on Google, customers love Angry Crab Shack! Check out some of the best reviews for our Atlanta, GA location:
Lori – ★★★★★
“Food was spectacular. My party of 7 really enjoyed our lunch. I had the shrimp and grits (very yum and cheesy) and cornbread. The manager kept walking around to check on each table, which I very much loved and appreciated. The music for afternoon time was great and enjoyable. Reasonable pricing and welcoming atmosphere. Overall I would definitely go back.”
Lindsey – ★★★★★
“First time guest! Good portion was amazing, as well as the flavor! Me and my daughter shared a broil for two and was impressed it came with king crab, snow crab and two lobster tails! I also tried the clam chowder which was definitely hittin! Lol we will return!”

Angry Crab Shack El Paso restaurant in El Paso, TX is located at 7019 N Mesa St, El Paso, TX 79912.  Crack open the flavor at our seafood boil restaurant located in El Paso, TX.

 Keep in Touch With Angry Crab Shack

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
	

	
 
 OUR REVIEWS
With 4.3 out of 5 stars on Google, customers love Angry Crab Shack! Check out some of the best reviews for our Atascocita location:
Cheryl – ★★★★★
“Great food, atmosphere and service. Met the owner Darrell. What a great host and chef! Love this place! Hope they are here for a long time to come! Had so much fun and the serving style is very unique. Don’t wear fancy clothes ‘cuz they will just get dirty. Can’t wait to go again! Great blueberry mojitos!”
Marcella – ★★★★★
“If you are looking for a flavorful boil this is the place. I have been there twice and everything was amazing!!! I recommend the lobster roll warmed, the hush puppies and of course the crab boil. Also they have really good drink options, you will not be disappointed! The staff was pleasant and owner is very cheerful and welcoming.”

sourceOrganization.description: Angry Crab Shack was founded by Former NFL player Ron Lou. Combining bold flavors in Asian food with his knowledge of seafood, Lou launched Angry Crab Shack in 2013 in Mesa, AZ. A family-friendly neighborhood restaurant, Angry Crab Shack offers a vibrant, memorable dining environment and high-quality seafood at a more affordable price. Now expanding into other states seafood lovers from near and far can find their way to Angry Crab Shack to experience the broad menu, outstanding service, and genuine hospitality in a one-of-a-kind environment.

hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. Soups & Salads Clam Chowder  As an appetizer or side to your main feast, our signature dinner soups and salads are a great addition to your meal.  Gumbo  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing, and croutons. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons, and your choice of dressing. ADD	Chilled Shrimp | Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Honey Mustard Shack Favorites  Lobster Roll  Angry Crab Shack is known for its flavorful seafood meals, but that’s not all we do. Sandwiches, Burgers, Lobster Rolls, Po’Boys and more are waiting for you!  shrimpandgrits (1)  JAMBALAYA	Traditional spicy Creole base with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and rice. TWIN LOBSTER ROLLS	Tender chunks of sweet lobster meat seasoned with house Cajun spice, served cold and nestled in two toasted New England rolls, with green onions, lemon, and warm butter. SHRIMP AND GRITS	Creamy southern style grits with tender shrimp covered in trifecta sauce. RED BEANS AND RICE	Tender red beans with onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic, and Cajun spices. Add choice of shrimp, grilled chicken, or sausage GRILLED SALMON	Salmon fillet grilled with garlic butter. Served with vegetables over rice or noodles and your choice of sauce. Seafood Boil Boil For Two  At Angry Crab Shack, we work miracles in the kitchen. We bring a taste of Louisiana cuisine right to your table with our Cajun seafood boil. We make our boil from scratch, mixing a mind-blowing combination of palate-pleasing spices and herbs. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! Henderson, NV  Cajun Seafood Restaurant. With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack in Henderson, NV has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu?

 
	

	
 
 DINNER MENU

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack in Henderson, NV lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick your seafood
Add a signature sauce
Spice up your boil
Add-in a side

 A juicy 8 oz filet, cooked medium to medium well*, served with a Maine lobster tail, corn on the cob, potatoes and a side of butter $38
 
 
 
 Steak Bowl
 SERVED WITH VEGETABLES OVER RICE OR NOODLES AND YOUR CHOICE OF SAUCE Tasty filet strips cooked medium to medium well* $19

 Your choice of a House or Caesar salad, topped with strips of tender grilled steak, cooked medium to medium well* $19

RINGS OR SWEET POTATO FRIES $1 Fresh off the grill steak, cooked medium to medium well*, cut into strips and served on a pretzel bun with horseradish mayo, bleu cheese and caramelized onions. $19

hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing. funder.description: Angry Crab Shack was founded by Former NFL player Ron Lou. Combining bold flavors in Asian food with his knowledge of seafood, Lou launched Angry Crab Shack in 2013 in Mesa, AZ. A family-friendly neighborhood restaurant, Angry Crab Shack offers a vibrant, memorable dining environment and high-quality seafood at a more affordable price. Now expanding into other states seafood lovers from near and far can find their way to Angry Crab Shack to experience the broad menu, outstanding service, and genuine hospitality in a one-of-a-kind environment.

At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. structuredData.description: The Angry Crab Shack is a seafood restaurant famous for its Cajun flavor and seafood boils. Our crab house in Tucson, AZ is serving up all your favorite seafood - fish, shrimp, oysters, crawfish, lobster, crab and more. Made into delicious Cajun dishes like jambalaya and gumbo, and classics like poboys, clam chowder, fish & chips and of course, our seafood boils. Pick your favorite seafood, sauces, spices and sides for a customized feast you're sure to love. Bring your family and friends to the Angry Crab Shack in Peoria to share in the experience, and let's get crackin'!

hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. Cajun Fried Pickles, Fried Shrimp, Hush Puppies, Calamari, Onion Rings, or Jumbo Wings LOBSTER CROSTINI	Succulent and sweet lobster meat with celery, green onions, and Cajun mayo. PHOENIX CHILDREN’S HOSPITAL FRIES	Crispy fries with Cajun or Lemon Pepper EZ PEEL AND EAT SHRIMP	Tender boiled shrimp, chilled and served with fresh Lemons and cocktail sauce. HUSH PUPPIES	Savory jalapeno cornbread fried deliciously crispy and served with ranch. ANGRY EDAMAME	Whole edamame boiled and smothered in Trifecta sauce. JUMBO WINGS	You sauce it! You spice it! (Buffalo, BBQ, Boil Sauces) CAJUN FRIED PICKLES	Fried crispy, and dusted with Cajun seasoning. Served with ranch. Soups & Salads Clam Chowder  As an appetizer or side to your main feast, our signature dinner soups and salads are a great addition to your meal.  Gumbo  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing, and croutons. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons, and your choice of dressing. ADD	Chilled Shrimp | Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Honey Mustard Shack Favorites  Lobster Roll  Angry Crab Shack is known for its flavorful seafood meals, but that’s not all we do. Sandwiches, Burgers, Lobster Rolls, Po’Boys and more are waiting for you!  shrimpandgrits (1)  JAMBALAYA	Traditional spicy Creole base with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and rice. TWIN LOBSTER ROLLS	Tender chunks of sweet lobster meat seasoned with house Cajun spice, served cold and nestled in two toasted New England rolls, with green onions, lemon, and warm butter. SHRIMP AND GRITS	Creamy southern style grits with tender shrimp covered in trifecta sauce. RED BEANS AND RICE	Tender red beans with onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic, and Cajun spices. Add choice of shrimp, grilled chicken, or sausage GRILLED SALMON	Salmon fillet grilled with garlic butter. Served with vegetables over rice or noodles and your choice of sauce. Seafood Boil Boil For Two  At Angry Crab Shack, we work miracles in the kitchen. We bring a taste of Louisiana cuisine right to your table with our Cajun seafood boil. We make our boil from scratch, mixing a mind-blowing combination of palate-pleasing spices and herbs. All you need to do is pick your favorite seafood item, choose a savory sauce, and spice it up the way you like. Roll Up Your Sleeves And Get Some at one of our locations! OTHER MENUS:  DINNER MENU  ⬤  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ORDER ONLINE  PCH_Logo  Benefiting Phoenix Children’s Hospital On behalf of all our patient families at Phoenix Children’s Hospital, we are honored and excited to partner with Angry Crab Shack and their customers in support of our patients. Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients. By dining at Angry Crab Shack and ordering one of the PCH Menu items, you are making a difference for children in our community. Great food for a great cause.

hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It!  OUR REVIEWS

Kevin – ★★★★★
“First, I was treated by friendly reception. The decor in the place is awesome and has lots of varied seating. I sat in the bar area. The apps were shrimp cocktail and fried calamari. Both were perfect. I ordered a crab cake sandwich with hush puppies. The sandwich was so flavorful. The hush puppies were cooked to perfection and the dipping sauce delectable.”
Alyson – ★★★★★
“Super cute family style lunch/dinner! Make sure you bring your markers to leave your mark. The gumbo was good and the crab boil was great. Our Server was a sweetheart and even cracked our crab open due to us not knowing how.”

hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! mentions.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers.  Seafood Boil Restaurant in Scottsdale
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack Talking Stick Way. has something for every seafood lover. Angry Crab Shack Talking Stick Way restaurant in Scottsdale, AZ is located at the Pavilions at Talking Stick on the corner of N Pima Road and Talking Stick Way. Add-in a side

Our crab house in Scottsdale, AZ is serving up all your favorite seafood - fish, shrimp, oysters, crawfish, lobster, crab and more. Made into delicious Cajun dishes like jambalaya and gumbo, and classics like poboys, clam chowder, fish & chips and of course, our seafood boils. Pick your favorite seafood, sauces, spices and sides for a customized feast you're sure to love. Bring your family and friends to the Angry Crab Shack in Peoria to share in the experience, and let's get crackin'!

hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing. OTHER MENUS:  DINNER MENU  ⬤  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ORDER ONLINE  PCH_Logo  Benefiting Phoenix Children’s Hospital On behalf of all our patient families at Phoenix Children’s Hospital, we are honored and excited to partner with Angry Crab Shack and their customers in support of our patients. Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients. By dining at Angry Crab Shack and ordering one of the PCH Menu items, you are making a difference for children in our community. Great food for a great cause.

 Angry Crab Shack – San Tan Valley
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack San Tan Valley has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu?
Our San Tan Valley location is in the shopping plaza at the cross streets of W Hunt Highway & N Gary Rd.
Visit our seafood boil and crab restaurant in San Tan today!

 
	

	
 
 CALL NOW

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack San Tan Valley lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences, such as cajun spicy seafood.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick your seafood
Add a signature sauce
Spice up your boil
Add-in a side

 
	

	
 
 
	
 
 Surf And Turf
 A juicy 8 oz filet, cooked medium to medium well*, served with a Maine lobster tail, corn on the cob, potatoes and a side of butter $38
 
 
 
 Steak Bowl
 SERVED WITH VEGETABLES OVER RICE OR NOODLES AND YOUR CHOICE OF SAUCE Tasty filet strips cooked medium to medium well* $19
 
 
	
	
 
 Steak Salad

hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. Sandwiches, Burgers, Lobster Rolls, Po’Boys and more are waiting for you!  shrimpandgrits (1)  JAMBALAYA	Traditional spicy Creole base with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and rice. TWIN LOBSTER ROLLS	Tender chunks of sweet lobster meat seasoned with house Cajun spice, served cold and nestled in two toasted New England rolls, with green onions, lemon, and warm butter. Add choice of shrimp, grilled chicken, or sausage GRILLED SALMON	Salmon fillet grilled with garlic butter. Served with vegetables over rice or noodles and your choice of sauce. Seafood Boil Boil For Two  At Angry Crab Shack, we work miracles in the kitchen. We bring a taste of Louisiana cuisine right to your table with our Cajun seafood boil. We make our boil from scratch, mixing a mind-blowing combination of palate-pleasing spices and herbs. All you need to do is pick your favorite seafood item, choose a savory sauce, and spice it up the way you like. Roll Up Your Sleeves And Get Some at one of our locations! Why settle for a plate? That’s Typical. Stand out from the crowd and grub down. When you hang out with us, you can sidestep the plate and plunge into a basket full of flavorful delicacies – while unleashing your inner foodie rebel. Each basket is served with our Cajun fries and your choice of potato salad, coleslaw, or beans.  Food8  Served with Cajun fries, sub onion rings or sweet potato fries. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). Phoenix – Indian School Cajun Seafood Restaurant. With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack in Phoenix, AZ has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu?
The Angry Crab Shack Indian School in Phoenix, AZ is located in the Arcadia Plaza on the Northeast corner of 28th St and Indian School Rd. Visit our seafood restaurant for the best seafood boil and crab legs near downtown Phoenix, or order online for take-out today!

hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! mentions.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. Sandwiches, Burgers, Lobster Rolls, Po’Boys and more are waiting for you!  shrimpandgrits (1)  JAMBALAYA	Traditional spicy Creole base with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and rice. TWIN LOBSTER ROLLS	Tender chunks of sweet lobster meat seasoned with house Cajun spice, served cold and nestled in two toasted New England rolls, with green onions, lemon, and warm butter. SHRIMP AND GRITS	Creamy southern style grits with tender shrimp covered in trifecta sauce. RED BEANS AND RICE	Tender red beans with onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic, and Cajun spices. Add choice of shrimp, grilled chicken, or sausage GRILLED SALMON	Salmon fillet grilled with garlic butter. Served with vegetables over rice or noodles and your choice of sauce. Seafood Boil Boil For Two  At Angry Crab Shack, we work miracles in the kitchen. We bring a taste of Louisiana cuisine right to your table with our Cajun seafood boil. We make our boil from scratch, mixing a mind-blowing combination of palate-pleasing spices and herbs. All you need to do is pick your favorite seafood item, choose a savory sauce, and spice it up the way you like. Roll Up Your Sleeves And Get Some at one of our locations! Why settle for a plate? That’s Typical. Stand out from the crowd and grub down. When you hang out with us, you can sidestep the plate and plunge into a basket full of flavorful delicacies – while unleashing your inner foodie rebel. Each basket is served with our Cajun fries and your choice of potato salad, coleslaw, or beans.  Food8  Served with Cajun fries, sub onion rings or sweet potato fries. Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients.  Cajun Seafood Restaurant in Phoenix
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack on Bell Rd. has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu?
Our Angry Crab Shack Bell Rd. restaurant in Phoenix, AZ is located at the Plaza de Campana on the Southeast corner of 32nd Street and Bell Road. Visit our Cajun and seafood restaurant in North Phoenix or order online for take-out today!

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack Bell Rd. lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick Your Seafood
Add a Signature Sauce
Spice Up Your Boil
Add-In a Side

 OUR REVIEWS
With 4 out of 5 stars on Google, customers love Angry Crab Shack! Check out some of the best reviews for our Phoenix (Bell Road) location:
Allison – ★★★★★
“Food was great! We went on a Friday at dinner time and were seated right away. Our server, Daniel, was awesome and attentive. It’s cafeteria style seating and a bar atmosphere so you’re going to get messy but that’s what you’re paying for. Seafood was hot and prices were appropriate for what we ordered. We will for sure be back.”
Jamilah – ★★★★★
“The staff are all friendly and attentive. They will answer as many questions as you ask with no irritation. They will make suggestions on menu items and drinks. I’ve tried several items there and only one that I didn’t like. Buy overall good food and great dining experience. Some of the pictures are from Mothers Day takeout.”

hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital.  Hush Puppies  OYSTERS	Juicy, plump raw* oysters from east and west coast. FRIED OYSTERS	Plump oysters, lightly breaded and cooked to perfection. Cajun Fried Pickles, Fried Shrimp, Hush Puppies, Calamari, Onion Rings, or Jumbo Wings LOBSTER CROSTINI	Succulent and sweet lobster meat with celery, green onions, and Cajun mayo. PHOENIX CHILDREN’S HOSPITAL FRIES	Crispy fries with Cajun or Lemon Pepper EZ PEEL AND EAT SHRIMP	Tender boiled shrimp, chilled and served with fresh Lemons and cocktail sauce. HUSH PUPPIES	Savory jalapeno cornbread fried deliciously crispy and served with ranch. ANGRY EDAMAME	Whole edamame boiled and smothered in Trifecta sauce. JUMBO WINGS	You sauce it! You spice it! (Buffalo, BBQ, Boil Sauces) CAJUN FRIED PICKLES	Fried crispy, and dusted with Cajun seasoning. Served with ranch. Soups & Salads Clam Chowder  As an appetizer or side to your main feast, our signature dinner soups and salads are a great addition to your meal.  Gumbo  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing, and croutons. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons, and your choice of dressing. ADD	Chilled Shrimp | Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Honey Mustard Shack Favorites  Lobster Roll  Angry Crab Shack is known for its flavorful seafood meals, but that’s not all we do. Sandwiches, Burgers, Lobster Rolls, Po’Boys and more are waiting for you!  shrimpandgrits (1)  JAMBALAYA	Traditional spicy Creole base with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and rice. TWIN LOBSTER ROLLS	Tender chunks of sweet lobster meat seasoned with house Cajun spice, served cold and nestled in two toasted New England rolls, with green onions, lemon, and warm butter. PO’BOY	 Cod Breaded Shrimp Grilled Shrimp Catfish Fried Oyster Breaded Shrimp and Fried Oyster Soft Shell Crab Lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, and Cajun Mayo on a baguette with a side of Cajun fries. SHRIMP AND GRITS	Creamy southern style grits with tender shrimp covered in trifecta sauce. RED BEANS AND RICE	Tender red beans with onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic, and Cajun spices. Add choice of shrimp, grilled chicken, or sausage GRILLED SALMON	Salmon fillet grilled with garlic butter. Served with vegetables over rice or noodles and your choice of sauce. Seafood Boil Boil For Two  At Angry Crab Shack, we work miracles in the kitchen. We bring a taste of Louisiana cuisine right to your table with our Cajun seafood boil. We make our boil from scratch, mixing a mind-blowing combination of palate-pleasing spices and herbs. All you need to do is pick your favorite seafood item, choose a savory sauce, and spice it up the way you like. Roll Up Your Sleeves And Get Some at one of our locations! Serves 2-3 people  ADD TO YOUR BAG  Seasonal Vegetables 4 Pieces of Sausage Hard-Boiled Egg Corn on the Cob Red Potato  Crispy Tofu  BoilForTwo  Sandwiches, Baskets & Bowls Food13  There are various types of baskets in this world, but none of them are as enticing as Angry Crab Shack lunch and dinner baskets. Why settle for a plate? That’s Typical. Stand out from the crowd and grub down. When you hang out with us, you can sidestep the plate and plunge into a basket full of flavorful delicacies – while unleashing your inner foodie rebel. Each basket is served with our Cajun fries and your choice of potato salad, coleslaw, or beans.  Food8  Served with Cajun fries, sub onion rings or sweet potato fries.  CRAB CAKE SANDWICH	Fried crispy with coleslaw, Cajun mayo and pickles on toasted Hawaiian Bun. Served with Ranch. SPICY FRIED CHICKEN SANDWICH	Southern fried chicken breast smothered in Trifecta sauce, with coleslaw and pickles on toasted Hawaiian bun. CHEESEBURGER	7 Ounce fresh Angus patty, 2-slices American cheese, with lettuce, pickle, Mayo, and crispy onion rings on a toasted Hawaiian bun. Served with Cajun fries and your choice of potato salad, coleslaw, or beans.  CATFISH	Southern style lightly breaded with fresh lemons and tartar sauce. GATOR NUGGETS	Breaded and fried served with Cajun mayo. FISH AND CHIPS	Cajun battered fillets served with fresh lemons and tartar sauce. SOFT SHELL CRAB	Light tempura battered fried crisp, seasoned, and served with fresh lemons and Cajun mayo. CHICKEN TENDERS	Home-style breaded and fried served with ranch. BREADED SHRIMP	Cajun battered tender shrimp fried crisp, served with fresh lemons and cocktail sauce. Served with vegetables over rice or noodles and your choice of sauce.  GRILLED SHRIMP	With garlic butter and vegetables over rice or noodles SCALLOP BOWL	Boil style with garlic butter and vegetables over rice or noodles VEGGIE BOWL	Full pound of fresh vegetable choice of sauce over rice or noodles. Add tofu  Our Additional Fixin’s The Fixin’s we have are the perfect complement to your dining experience. No meal is complete unless you grab an item off our sides menu.
