hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It!  Angry Crab Shack – Peoria (Cactus Rd)
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack Peoria location has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu?
Our Angry Crab Shack location in Peoria, AZ  is located on the Northwest corner of 75th Ave and Cactus Rd. Visit our Cajun and seafood restaurant near Peoria or order online for take-out today!

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack Peoria lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences, such as cajun spicy seafood.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick your seafood
Add a signature sauce
Spice up your boil
Add-in a side

 
	

	
 
 
	
 
 Surf And Turf
 A juicy 8 oz filet, cooked medium to medium well*, served with a Maine lobster tail, corn on the cob, potatoes and a side of butter $38
 
 
 
 Steak Bowl
 SERVED WITH VEGETABLES OVER RICE OR NOODLES AND YOUR CHOICE OF SAUCE Tasty filet strips cooked medium to medium well* $19
 
 
	
	
 
 Steak Salad
 Your choice of a House or Caesar salad, topped with strips of tender grilled steak, cooked medium to medium well* $19

 SERVED WITH CAJUN FRIES, SUB ONION
RINGS OR SWEET POTATO FRIES $1 Fresh off the grill steak, cooked medium to medium well*, cut into strips and served on a pretzel bun with horseradish mayo, bleu cheese and caramelized onions. $19

Kimberlie – ★★★★★
“Loved it. Great food and excellent service. We had the gator bites and Cajun fries. We also ordered a snow crab and shrimp Cajun boil with the trifecta sauces and made it hot. It was delicious. Some of the best seafood I’ve had in Arizona. Highly recommend. The picture is what we had to bring home because we got full.”
Dawson – ★★★★★
“Absolutely to die for!!! Best dang crab I’ve ever had! There are multiple flavors/spices to choose from and they’re all amazing!! On top of the amazing food, it has a great atmosphere and the whole experience is wonderful. This is always the first place I take out of town guests to.”

hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! structuredData.description: The Angry Crab Shack is a seafood restaurant famous for its Cajun flavor and seafood boils. Our crab house in Mesa, AZ is serving up all your favorite seafood - fish, shrimp, oysters, crawfish, lobster, crab and more. Made into delicious Cajun dishes like jambalaya and gumbo, and classics like poboys, clam chowder, fish & chips and of course, our seafood boils. Pick your favorite seafood, sauces, spices and sides for a customized feast you're sure to love. Bring your family and friends to the Angry Crab Shack in Peoria to share in the experience, and let's get crackin'!

hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. Sandwiches, Burgers, Lobster Rolls, Po’Boys and more are waiting for you!  shrimpandgrits (1)  JAMBALAYA	Traditional spicy Creole base with chicken, sausage, shrimp, and rice. We make our boil from scratch, mixing a mind-blowing combination of palate-pleasing spices and herbs. All you need to do is pick your favorite seafood item, choose a savory sauce, and spice it up the way you like. Roll Up Your Sleeves And Get Some at one of our locations! Why settle for a plate? That’s Typical. Stand out from the crowd and grub down. When you hang out with us, you can sidestep the plate and plunge into a basket full of flavorful delicacies – while unleashing your inner foodie rebel. Each basket is served with our Cajun fries and your choice of potato salad, coleslaw, or beans.  Food8  Served with Cajun fries, sub onion rings or sweet potato fries. hasMenu.name: Angry Crab Shack Lunch Menu
hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital.  Hush Puppies  OYSTERS	Juicy, plump raw* oysters from east and west coast. FRIED OYSTERS	Plump oysters, lightly breaded and cooked to perfection. CHARRED OYSTERS	Plump oysters with garlic butter, Parmesan cheese, and crushed red pepper. 1/2 dozen | 1 dozen ONION RINGS	Golden crispy and served with ranch. CALAMARI	Fried light and crisp, with cocktail sauce and fresh Lemons. FRIED SAMPLER	Wanna Share? Choose three of your favorites! Cajun Fried Pickles, Fried Shrimp, Hush Puppies, Calamari, Onion Rings, or Jumbo Wings LOBSTER CROSTINI	Succulent and sweet lobster meat with celery, green onions, and Cajun mayo. PHOENIX CHILDREN’S HOSPITAL FRIES	Crispy fries with Cajun or Lemon Pepper EZ PEEL AND EAT SHRIMP	Tender boiled shrimp, chilled and served with fresh Lemons and cocktail sauce. HUSH PUPPIES	Savory jalapeno cornbread fried deliciously crispy and served with ranch. ANGRY EDAMAME	Whole edamame boiled and smothered in Trifecta sauce. JUMBO WINGS	You sauce it! You spice it! (Buffalo, BBQ, Boil Sauces) CAJUN FRIED PICKLES	Fried crispy, and dusted with Cajun seasoning. Served with ranch. Soups & Salads Clam Chowder  As an appetizer or side to your main feast, our signature dinner soups and salads are a great addition to your meal.  Gumbo  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing, and croutons. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips).  Angry Crab Shack – Goodyear, AZ
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack in Goodyear, AZ on N. Litchfield Rd. has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu? Explore our Dinner Menu and indulge your taste buds.

 
	

	
 
 ORDER ONLINE

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack in Goodyear lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick Your Seafood
Add a Signature Sauce
Spice Up Your Boil
Add-In a Side

 
	

	
 
 
	
 
 Surf And Turf
 A juicy 8 oz filet, cooked medium to medium well*, served with a Maine lobster tail, corn on the cob, potatoes and a side of butter $38
 
 
 
 Steak Bowl
 SERVED WITH VEGETABLES OVER RICE OR NOODLES AND YOUR CHOICE OF SAUCE Tasty filet strips cooked medium to medium well* $19
 
 
	
	
 
 Steak Salad
 Your choice of a House or Caesar salad, topped with strips of tender grilled steak, cooked medium to medium well* $19

RINGS OR SWEET POTATO FRIES $1 Fresh off the grill steak, cooked medium to medium well*, cut into strips and served on a pretzel bun with horseradish mayo, bleu cheese and caramelized onions. $19

 Keep in Touch With Angry Crab Shack

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
	

	
 
 OUR REVIEWS
With 4 out of 5 stars on Google, customers love Angry Crab Shack! Check out some of the best reviews for our Goodyear location:
Paige – ★★★★★
“Highly recommend this seafood restaurant. Usually, I do not trust restaurants that serve seafood if they are not close to the ocean. Walking in, Angry crabs transports you to a beach in Florida. There are the salty smells of seafood and they have fresh tanks.
The food is served in a bag for you to eat on the table southern style. Prepare to be messy, although they do provide bibs and gloves to eat with.
The service was exceptional. Waited was very kind with our request. One tip- if you do not like spicy, do not get any level of spice. It is rather spicy..”
Brittany – ★★★★★
“not being near the coast and judging by the outside of the building i was a little iffy. however, my expectations were exceeded! the drinks were really good, the food was nothing short of amazing, and the atmosphere and service were great as well. 10/10 would highly recommend!!!”

hasMenu.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. We make our boil from scratch, mixing a mind-blowing combination of palate-pleasing spices and herbs. All you need to do is pick your favorite seafood item, choose a savory sauce, and spice it up the way you like. Roll Up Your Sleeves And Get Some at one of our locations! Why settle for a plate? That’s Typical. Stand out from the crowd and grub down. When you hang out with us, you can sidestep the plate and plunge into a basket full of flavorful delicacies – while unleashing your inner foodie rebel. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! OTHER MENUS:  DINNER MENU  ⬤  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ORDER ONLINE  PCH_Logo  Benefiting Phoenix Children’s Hospital On behalf of all our patient families at Phoenix Children’s Hospital, we are honored and excited to partner with Angry Crab Shack and their customers in support of our patients. Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients. By dining at Angry Crab Shack and ordering one of the PCH Menu items, you are making a difference for children in our community. Great food for a great cause.

 ORDER ONLINE

 
	

	
 
 Seafood Restaurant in Casa Grande
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable; Angry Crab Shack (Casa Grande) has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our customizable seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu? Explore our Dinner Menu and indulge your taste buds. Angry Crab Shack Florence Blvd restaurant in Casa Grande, AZ is located about 3/4 of a mile west of the I-10. Come in to try our seafood boil with Asian-Cajun flavors, or order online for take-out/delivery when we open!

 
	

	
 
 ORDER ONLINE

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack Broadway Blvd. lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences, such as cajun spicy seafood.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick your seafood
Add a signature sauce
Spice up your boil
Add-in a side

 
	

	
 
 
	
 
 Surf And Turf
 A juicy 8 oz filet, cooked medium to medium well*, served with a Maine lobster tail, corn on the cob, potatoes and a side of butter $38
 
 
 
 Steak Bowl
 SERVED WITH VEGETABLES OVER RICE OR NOODLES AND YOUR CHOICE OF SAUCE Tasty filet strips cooked medium to medium well* $19
 
 
	
	
 
 Steak Salad
 Your choice of a House or Caesar salad, topped with strips of tender grilled steak, cooked medium to medium well* $19
 
 
 
 Steak Sandwich
 SERVED WITH CAJUN FRIES, SUB ONION
RINGS OR SWEET POTATO FRIES $1 Fresh off the grill steak, cooked medium to medium well*, cut into strips and served on a pretzel bun with horseradish mayo, bleu cheese and caramelized onions. $19

 Keep in Touch With Angry Crab Shack

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
	

	
 
 OUR REVIEWS
With 4 out of 5 stars on Google, customers love Angry Crab Shack! Check out some of the best reviews for our Casa Grande location:
Robin – ★★★★★
“This was our first visit to the Angry Crab Shack!!! It was really a fun dinner!!! They give you a marker and encourage you to write on the walls!!! We had the catfish basket with the Cajun fries and coleslaw! Our waitress Erica was really informative and really nice!!! Great service with a smile!!! We will definitely be going back and have their seafood buckets!!!”
Scott – ★★★★★
“What a fun dinner. We had a boil. Our server told us they were short handed that evening, however, we lacked for nothing! The bartender made my partner a fabulous sangria! Yes made, not out of a bottle! Was a dinner on our top 10 list. We will be back!”

sponsor.description: Angry Crab Shack was founded by Former NFL player Ron Lou. Combining bold flavors in Asian food with his knowledge of seafood, Lou launched Angry Crab Shack in 2013 in Mesa, AZ. A family-friendly neighborhood restaurant, Angry Crab Shack offers a vibrant, memorable dining environment and high-quality seafood at a more affordable price. Now expanding into other states seafood lovers from near and far can find their way to Angry Crab Shack to experience the broad menu, outstanding service, and genuine hospitality in a one-of-a-kind environment.

At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients. By dining at Angry Crab Shack and ordering one of the PCH Menu items, you are making a difference for children in our community. Great food for a great cause.

structuredData.description: The Angry Crab Shack is a seafood restaurant famous for its Cajun flavor and seafood boils. Our crab house in Atascocita, TX is serving up all your favorite seafood - fish, shrimp, oysters, crawfish, lobster, crab and more. Made into delicious Cajun dishes like jambalaya and gumbo, and classics like poboys, clam chowder, fish & chips and of course, our seafood boils. Pick your favorite seafood, sauces, spices and sides for a customized feast you're sure to love. Bring your family and friends to the Angry Crab Shack in Peoria to share in the experience, and let's get crackin'!

 About Angry Crab Shack
 
 
	
 
	

	
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 California native Ron Lou spent four years in the National Football League playing center for the Houston Oilers then the Philadelphia Eagles. After retiring from professional football, he spent the next 35 years creating five different restaurant concepts, including a breakfast eatery, a sports bar and three different Chinese restaurants. Ready for another success, Lou set out to create something unique – not just another wing, burger or pizza place.
In 2013 the culmination of Lou’s efforts resulted in the opening of Angry Crab Shack. Combining bold flavors customary in Asian cuisine with his knowledge of seafood, Ron introduced seafood boil to Mesa, Arizona. A family-friendly neighborhood restaurant, Angry Crab Shack offers a vibrant, memorable dining environment and high-quality seafood at a more affordable price.
Setting his sights on the expansion of Angry Crab Shack, he made it a priority to build a family culture for his employees and an attitude of giving back. As the number of locations grew, Angry Crab Shack’s commitment to the community has followed. Establishing long-term relationships with local charities and donating to those in need is at the heart of Angry Crab Shack.
Now expanding into other states seafood lovers from near and far can find their way to Angry Crab Shack to experience the broad menu, outstanding service, and genuine hospitality in a one-of-a-kind environment.

 
	

	
 
 Our Passion is to Serve
Delicious Seafood
To Our Guests in a Fun,
Sometimes Loud, and Always Very
Casual Environment.
Find A Location

 
	

	
 
 We love groups both big and small and celebrations of every kind. Guests come ready to bib up and dig into some good eatin’. Our Angry Crab family extends to our guests but starts with our employees. Our crabbin’ culture is all about a fun family environment. We like to get messy and have a great time. We created this concept with the intent to grow our family, give opportunities to emerging entrepreneurs, and bring good cooking everywhere we expand.

 Angry Crab Shack – Happy Valley Rd. Phoenix
With a flavor experience so good it remains indescribable, Angry Crab Shack Happy Valley in Phoenix, AZ has something for every seafood lover. Have you tried our custom Cajun seafood boil or one of the amazing sandwiches, appetizers, or salads on the menu? Visit us today, we are located in the Happy Valley Town Center in North Phoenix.
Explore our Dinner Menu and indulge your taste buds.

 
	

	
 
 CALL NOW

 
	

	
 
 

 
	
SpecialsEventsAmenitiesSpecials
	
 
 

 
	

	
 
 The Seafood Boil Experience
If you are looking for the ultimate crab-in-a-bag, but want a unique twist, you have come to the right place. Angry Crab Shack lets you customize for your personal flavor preferences, such as cajun spicy seafood.
The process is easy, and the results are amazing, all you have to do is:

Pick Your Seafood
Add a Signature Sauce
Spice Up Your Boil
Add-In a Side

 
	

	
 
 
	
 
 Surf And Turf
 A juicy 8 oz filet, cooked medium to medium well*, served with a Maine lobster tail, corn on the cob, potatoes and a side of butter $38
 
 
 
 Steak Bowl
 SERVED WITH VEGETABLES OVER RICE OR NOODLES AND YOUR CHOICE OF SAUCE Tasty filet strips cooked medium to medium well* $19
 
 
	
	
 
 Steak Salad
 Your choice of a House or Caesar salad, topped with strips of tender grilled steak, cooked medium to medium well* $19
 
 
 
 Steak Sandwich
 SERVED WITH CAJUN FRIES, SUB ONION
RINGS OR SWEET POTATO FRIES $1 Fresh off the grill steak, cooked medium to medium well*, cut into strips and served on a pretzel bun with horseradish mayo, bleu cheese and caramelized onions. $19

Another server in our area, Jordan, was awesome. I watched her place a bib on an older lady dining with her granddaughter. She helped the two of them crack their lobster and crab. hasMenu.text: We serve lunch Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. with a lunch menu that can’t be beaten. We serve awesome food at affordable prices, so bring a few friends or co-workers with you. It’s a great place to kick back and relax with an atmosphere filled with fun and vibrant energy.  Angry Crab Shack is an ideal place for hosting great, fun-filled office parties and celebrations. The food is always fresh and our servers are super-friendly. You get to take a load off while enjoying a robust mix of delicacies, such as soups, salads, seafood, and more. Guest favorites range from gumbo and grilled chicken to grilled salmon and our popular salads. We keep the eats light yet filling at the same time so you can satisfy your hunger without worrying about feeling sluggish after you’re done chowing down.  **Menus & pricing may vary based on location. Please visit our locations page to view each location’s individual menu. Curbside pickup is available!  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack - Burger and Fries  Soups & Salads 2021-10 Clam-Chowder-cutout01  About Our Soups and Salads  Before you order your main course, try our signature dinner soups and salads. We bet you will find a favorite you can’t live without. Get things started with some gumbo made with homemade sausage, shrimp, and crawfish stew, and rice. Or, how about some Boston-style clam chowder to make you feel all warm and fuzzy on the inside?  When it comes to salads, we serve them up clean, mean, and very green. You get your choice of Caesar or house salad. We bring you mountains of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, and super greens. We know many of our guests like to level up their salads, so we offer a choice of chilled shrimp, grilled shrimp, breaded shrimp, breaded chicken, grilled chicken, grilled salmon, sliced beef, and crispy tofu.  What’s a salad without a delectable dressing? You can drench those fresh greens with ranch, balsamic, Caesar, or herb Cajun dressing. Voila, the perfect starter before a tasty dinner.  2021-10 Gumbo-cutout04  GUMBO	Homemade Creole stew with shrimp, sausage, crawfish, and rice. CLAM CHOWDER	Boston style clam chowder. HOUSE SALAD	Artisan and romaine lettuce with tomatoes, cucumbers, croutons and your choice of dressing. CAESAR SALAD	Chopped romaine, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing and croutons. ADD	Chilled Shrimp| Breaded Shrimp | Grilled Shrimp | Breaded Chicken | Grilled Chicken | Grilled Salmon | Crispy Tofu DRESSINGS	Ranch | Balsamic | Caesar | Herb Cajun Lunch Bowls grilled chicken bowl  About Our Angry Lunch Bowls  Grabbing something off our Angry Crab Shack lunch bowls menu is the way to go when you want all the tasty goodness served up in a nice little bundle. You can dig into healthy portions of sausage, grilled shrimp, sliced beef, grilled chicken, naked P&D Shrimp, breaded chicken, crispy tofu, or breaded shrimp. But, these bowls are never complete without saucing or spicing it up!  Take your bowl to the next level with your choice of Traditional Boil or Sweet N Tangy sauce; both of which are dairy-free and water-based. Try the Pacific Rim or the Trifecta, which is a combination of garlic, lemon pepper, and Cajun. Our spices are ranked from zero to six on the hotness scale. On the zero to one scale is Me No Likey Spice and Mild (Wimpy). Number three and four are Medium (Sizzlin’) and Hot (I Can’t Feel My Lips). In the four to six range, you get Angry Ghost (Inferno), Scorching Scorpion, and Ridiculously Hot.  grilled shrimp bowl  Choose It! mentions.text: Dinner Menu OTHER MENUS:  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ⬤  DRINK MENU  ⬤  DESSERT MENU  ORDER ONLINE  JUMP TO >  Appetizers  Soups & Salads  Sandwiches  Seafood Boil  Baskets  Angry Crab Shack Lobster Dinner Ideas  No one wants to spend tons of money to enjoy fine-tasting seafood. At Angry Crab Shack, see our dinner menu ideas! We have what you need to satisfy your seafood cravings—without blowing your paycheck. Our doors are open every day so you can chow down no matter the day of the week.  Our dinner menu offers awesome appetizers, scrumptious sandwiches, savory soups and salads, and a classic seafood boil with Asian-Cajun-inspired flavors. We don’t stop there! When you look over the menu, make sure you add a signature side item (or two or three). You can even indulge in our popular basket meals. Your hands are your utensils and the table is your plate. When you walk in hungry, we make sure you leave with a full belly and a big smile.  Note: Menu prices differ by location. Please see the menus on your local location’s page for pricing.  CONTACT US Angry Crab Shack Food for Dinner  Appetizers Gotta Have me some!   Fried Sampler  Kick-off your meal with our tantalizing appetizers. From enticing oysters served char or raw to succulent lobster crostini, we’ve got it all! Don’t forget to order a basket of our Cajun Fries to benefit your local Children’s Hospital. OTHER MENUS:  DINNER MENU  ⬤  LUNCH MENU  ⬤  KIDS MENU  ORDER ONLINE  PCH_Logo  Benefiting Phoenix Children’s Hospital On behalf of all our patient families at Phoenix Children’s Hospital, we are honored and excited to partner with Angry Crab Shack and their customers in support of our patients. Phoenix Children’s Hospital is one of the largest and most respected children’s hospitals in the nation,  providing world-class care in 75 subspecialty fields of pediatric medicine. At Phoenix Children’s, we provide care for the most critically ill and injured children when they need it most. The hospital treated over 135,000 patients last year, and within five years, 1 in 4 Arizona children will have received care from a Phoenix Children’s provider.  As a non-profit hospital, we could not do the work we do without the generous support from our local community. More than 60 of the hospital’s programs are funded solely through charitable giving, and these programs help make the hospital more comfortable for our young patients. By dining at Angry Crab Shack and ordering one of the PCH Menu items, you are making a difference for children in our community. Great food for a great cause.
